newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Bulbank to meet yen bond payments Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Bulbank to meet yen bond payments Dec 2.

text.p: Bulgaria's biggest state-owned bank, Bulbank, will pay principal and interest worth 2.713 billion yen on a 10-year bond issue due by December 2, a bank official said.
"Bulbank will transfer to the Mitsubishi Bank of Tokyo 2.5 billion yen for principal payments and the remaining interest of 213 million yen by December 2," a Bulbank official told Reuters.
The issue was underwritten in Bulbank's previous name -- Bulgarian Foreign Trade Bank -- in 1988 by the Mitsubishi Bank of Tokyo.
The issue worth 10 billion yen bears an annual coupon of 5.7 percent and is due to mature on December 5, 1998. It was placed with Japanese investors.
In November, Bulbank serviced principal and coupon payments worth 1.678 billion yen due on another Japanese bond.
Bulbank's payments on yen-denominated bond issues totalled some $39.5 million this year, the official said.
Bulbank's future Japanese bond payments obligations are $66.7 million next year, $63.4 million in 1998 and $37.5 million in 1999.
